messages.text: Được nhé, mình kể dài vừa thôi: con mèo trắng lông xù gặp mèo đen nhỏ, rồi hai bạn đi qua chiếc ghế đỏ, ngửi mùi cam, nhìn cửa sổ, chạy chậm quanh phòng, rồi nằm cuộn tròn ngủ rất êm. In English, try: “The white cat and the black cat were friends.”
messages.translation: Okay, I'll make it moderately long: the fluffy white cat met a little black cat. They walked past the red chair, smelled an orange, looked out the window, ran slowly around the room, then curled up and slept peacefully. In English, try: "The white cat and the black cat were friends."
